title: Sidewalk Labs: coordination death spiral
summary: Fear travels at internet speed; trust builds at relationship speed. When one body (government, private sector or civil society) retreated, it raised fear and eroded trust among the others, accelerating their retreat. The Quayside project collapsed in 2020: coordination is a living system that has to survive politics, fear and time.
source: Ch04 — 'When Urban Coordination Fails: The Sidewalk Labs Lesson' (replaces the 23andMe figure)
